output.summary: A deciduous flowering tree native to the Indian subcontinent and Myanmar. It has rounded, two-lobed leaves and conspicuous fragrant pink flowers, followed by long seed pods. Young leaves and flowers are edible; in Philippine cuisine, the citrusy, sour leaves flavor soups or are prepared as a pickle condiment, while flowers are used in pickles and curries.
